verdict.rationale: A framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any official SDK or client library. Probes found no OpenAPI spec. The documented tooling (the sv CLI, svelte-package, and the MCP server) belongs to other stories and does not count as SDK support.
